hints.title: Sign Assignment
hints.text: Every element nums[i] either begins a new subarray with positive sign +nums[i], or continues the previous subarray flipping sign to -nums[i].

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Let dp[0] be the max cost ending at index i with nums[i] added positively, and dp[1] with nums[i] subtracted negatively.

hints.title: Transitions
hints.text: New dp[0] = max(dp[0], dp[1]) + nums[i], and new dp[1] = dp[0] - nums[i].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using two scalar state variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the 2-state markovian alternation of signs.
